mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate level is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated rates increase the discount rate for equity valuations and signal tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative due to heightened expectations of economic slowdown and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the Fed is forced to tighten further.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% AND UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized GDP growth rate (from the latest quarterly release) exceeds 2.0%, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are positive, reflecting strong economic momentum that supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeds 102.5, indicating strong supply-side economic activity, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are positive as robust production supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 102.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 158000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 158000 AND UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPI inflation rate (computed from CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative due to increased risk of central bank tightening and reduced real disposable income.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are positive as strong labor conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
